text:
Interviewed daughter-in-law.
Head of house pays insurance 3/- wk. - union dues 9' wk.
Son-in-law pays 8/-? tax, 2/3 insurance.
Rent is shared by couples - also food expenses -
not known how much financial contribution to food would be.

House an old one in good condition back from road -
vegetables - tomatos, lettuce, silver beet at back - flowers in
front on bank - boxes of flowers on verandah.
House needs painting inside.

Block 40' x 80'.
